headline: The peso suffered its worst weekly setback since August 2024
summary: The Mexican peso fell sharply over the week, breaking a two-week run of gains against the US dollar. It recorded its steepest weekly decline since August 2024.
why: The peso is one of the most traded emerging-market currencies, and its moves affect Mexican inflation, corporate dollar debt and regional risk sentiment.
original_headline: El peso sufrió su peor descalabro semanal desde agosto de 2024
